skills.name: Cat Kagura
lines: Skill automatically used for 3 actions (does not consume MP), unless interrupted by status effect.
* Each action:

** Stack 1 Catwisp on user then Earth type Slash attack on all enemies (XL) and Restore all party members HP and 50% damage barrier to all party members (1 time) and Critical rate of all party members +100% (1 move)
** Skill Multiplier based on nth action:
** Healing Multiplier based on number of Catwisps:
* After 3rd action:
** Restore all party members' MP 30%
** Consume all Catwisps
Catwisp: +20 PWR (max stack 3)
